tools.name: list_occasions
tools.description: Lists the occasions this group-card service supports, with the value to pass to create_board.

tools.name: suggest_prompts
tools.description: Suggests ready questions the organiser can show participants, for an occasion. Optional recipientName fills the name in.

tools.name: occasion_date
tools.description: Next date and the one after for a professional day (Russian service) or a Jewish holiday (Hebrew service), computed from the calendar rule, never stale. For fasts and memorial days the answer says greetings are not customary.

tools.name: board_status
tools.description: Shows how collection is going for a card: how many have signed, when collection closes and when it opens. Takes the participants' invite link.

tools.name: create_board
tools.description: Creates a group greeting card that several people sign before it opens on a set date, and returns the link to send to participants. Requires the organiser's email: the full management links are sent there, and a one-time 'take control' link is returned. Ask the person for anything missing; never inv

tools.name: gift_budget
tools.description: How much each person gives toward a group gift: divide the cost by those who will actually pay, round down; the organiser adds the rest. Or, from a per-person amount, the total budget. Pass exactly one of giftCost or perPerson. Amounts are in the service's currency.
